reason: Pre-submission review identified two inferential gaps in the RC7 headline: the observed 92% boundary-crossing allocation and near-zero beta-diversity slope lacked an explicit uniform-activation null comparator, and the title's 'without detectable homogenization' wording relied on non-significance rather than a prespecified practical-equivalence margin for Sørensen dissimilarity.
authorized_analyses: One uniform-activation null model that preserves dry-side species x stop propensity and matches each pair's observed wet incidence magnitude in expectation, then compares the observed four-component incidence allocation and Sørensen slope with the null distribution.
One practical-equivalence test for the rainfall-contrast slope of mean pairwise Sørensen dissimilarity, using a fixed +/-0.025 dissimilarity-unit margin and the exact-consecutive-year sensitivity.

decision_dependency.uniform_null_not_rejected: RC8 must not claim that boundary-crossing expansion is more structured than expected under uniform activation; title/story must be rewritten toward expansion consistent with uniform activation.
decision_dependency.uniform_null_rejected: RC8 may retain the matrix-structure interpretation if the deviation is robust across the frozen baseline-smoothing sensitivities.
decision_dependency.sorensen_equivalence_pass: Practical-equivalence language may be used for the Sørensen slope only within the fixed margin.
decision_dependency.sorensen_equivalence_fail: Title must retain only 'no detectable homogenization' wording and cannot imply practical invariance of Sørensen dissimilarity.

not_authorized: new ecological endpoints beyond the two analyses above
retuning the uniform-null model after readback
changing the Sørensen margin after readback
